metadata.definition: 待编辑判断的引用：译文含可唯一匹配的原文链接，尚需决定是否补充对应知乎译文。
limitations: These are exact, unique original-URL matches; they are candidates for adding a local Zhihu link, not proof that every external link should be replaced.
Shared book roots, multiple translations of one source, and other ambiguous source URLs are excluded from this report.

live_public_verification.unverified_behavior: new articles use archive snapshot; no live reread is claimed

candidate_recheck.scope: Only existing candidate pairs were rechecked against the local archive; historical live-check dates are unchanged.

editorial_review.scope: Historical candidate dispositions, not a new full-source or live-Zhihu scan.
